candidates.source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP) — notices
candidates.why_relevant: Since 2019 ECEPP is the ONLY place EBRD clients publish General Procurement Notices, prequalification, shortlisting and contract-award notices for EBRD-financed public-sector contracts. Ukraine notices found in search (e.g. 'Ukraine: Procurement Practices Reform', 'Ukraine: PIS Consultant and FIDIC Engineer') confirm live UA flow. Notices name the implementing entity, budget and technology scope, typically months before any national tender.
candidates.access_status: public listing; full documents require free supplier registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scrape/monitor of notice search filtered country=Ukraine; individual notices are stable deep-links (viewNotice.html?displayNoticeId=NNNN). Consider registered account for document-level detail.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from EBRD procurement pages

candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read for taxonomy; low-frequency re-check for rule changes.

candidates.source_name: EBRD consultancy/technical-cooperation assignment notices (ECEPP consultancy stream)

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor consultancy notice stream filtered to Ukraine + financial institutions sector.

candidates.why_relevant: Project Procurement Plans list every planned contract, package description, estimated cost, method and expected dates — the single richest forward-looking artefact in the WB pipeline. Confirmed Ukraine examples retrieved in search (P508490, P1710501).

candidates.why_relevant: Awards of WB's own corporate contracts (>US$100k), including advisory and payment-service-provider engagements. Indirect for UA but reveals which vendors WBG trusts for payments work, occasionally Ukraine-scoped.

candidates.why_relevant: IFC works through partner banks rather than public tenders (US$2bn Ukraine package; digital infrastructure among priority areas). negative_findings.description: No EBRD Ukraine procurement notice specifically scoped to a bank payment system / payment infrastructure consultancy was surfaced by the seed query. UA notices found were procurement-reform, project-implementation-support and FIDIC-engineer assignments.
negative_findings.result_summary: ECEPP confirmed as the live UA notice channel, but the specific payments-technology assignment was not located from open web search; it would require an in-portal filtered search (sector = financial institutions).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core hypothesis (donor notices precede national tenders for payment infrastructure) is plausible but not yet evidenced; a portal-side search is needed before concluding absence.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetches of both https://dream.gov.ua/ and https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/procurement returned only client-side loading placeholders.
negative_findings.result_summary: No content extracted; both are single-page applications. Treated as unverified-but-presumed-live hypotheses, not dead sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the highest-priority sources in this cell cannot be collected by plain HTTP fetch; the collection design must budget for headless rendering or API discovery.

negative_findings.description: Platforms named 'RELINK', 'REPOWER' and 'PREPARE' were cited by a trade-body source as IFI-financed procurement channels for Ukraine alongside Prozorro and DREAM, but a targeted Ukrainian-language search returned no corroboration and no canonical URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Named-but-unconfirmed. No URL is recorded for them because none was actually found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If real, these are additional donor procurement pipelines outside both Prozorro and lender portals — a blind spot. If they are internal DREAM modules, that changes the collection design.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language donor-side terminology was found for payment-infrastructure-specific procurement objects (e.g. a standard UA phrase for 'payment terminal / acquiring system' in IFI notice titles); IFI notices addressed to UA are overwhelmingly published in English only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian-language searching surfaced rules, commentary and press coverage (Prozorro Infobox, Mineconomy, KMU, NISS, AHK) but essentially no Ukrainian-language primary notices from EBRD/WB/UNDP.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language monitoring for this cell should target the meta/rules/commentary layer and Prozorro, not the lender portals; English is the operative notice language.

negative_findings.description: UNOPS eSourcing requires a UNGM vendor account; UNGM's alerting layer (Tender Alert Service / UNGM Pro) is a paid product; DevelopmentAid is membership-gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery-layer data remains publicly listed, but structured/alerting access is commercial.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated near-real-time monitoring may require either registered accounts or polling the free public listings; ToS review is needed before any bulk collection.

negative_findings.description: USAID has been closed and its continuing Ukraine programmes, including oversight of direct budget support, transferred to the US Department of State; no successor Ukraine financial-sector solicitation was identified in open search.
negative_findings.result_summary: The USAID.gov / former USAID Ukraine procurement channel is no longer the right monitoring target; SAM.gov plus State Department country pages are.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historic collection rules pointing at USAID business-forecast pages would silently go stale and produce a false 'no US activity' signal.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up pass for CEB (procurement notices) and bilateral DFIs, each of which publishes its own notice board or project disclosures naming UA partner banks.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass identified entry points but did not execute in-portal filtered searches (ECEPP country=Ukraine + sector=financial institutions; UNGM country=Ukraine; WB opportunities country=Ukraine).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser pass against each portal's own filter UI to enumerate current UA financial-sector notices and confirm the real notice volume and cadence.

coverage_gaps.description: No API or bulk-data endpoint was confirmed for ECEPP, UNGM, UNDP procurement notices or DREAM. Only TED, the EU Funding & Tenders Portal, SAM.gov and (by policy commitment) DREAM's OCDS publication are believed machine-readable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each portal for an underlying JSON/XHR endpoint and locate DREAM's OCDS release feed; document per-source collection method before building collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: No mechanism was established for linking a donor-side notice (lender portal) to the downstream Ukrainian tender in Prozorro for the same package.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a crosswalk on project ID / implementing entity / package description, exploiting the fact that sub-threshold IFI packages now run inside Prozorro under a tagged donor procedure.

coverage_gaps.description: Ukrainian-language coverage in this cell is concentrated on rules/commentary sources; no uk-language primary donor notice corpus was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm whether ECEPP/WB/UNDP publish uk-language versions of UA notices; if not, record English as the operative notice language for this cell and shift uk-language monitoring to Prozorro and government channels.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/retrospective source was secured for expired donor notices, which usually disappear from lender portals after closing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate WB Documents & Reports and Contract Awards datasets plus web-archive snapshots of ECEPP/UNGM notices as the historical backbone.

brief: Donor-financed procurement touching Ukraine's financial infrastructure is published across three distinct layers: lender-owned notice boards (EBRD's ECEPP, World Bank projects/documents including STEP-derived Procurement Plans, UNDP's notice portal, UNGM/UNOPS eSourcing), EU instruments (TED, the EU Funding & Tenders Portal, EU4Business and the EU Delegation), and the Ukrainian national layer where, under the 2023 CEB/EBRD/EIB/World Bank harmonisation memorandum, sub-threshold IFI packages now run inside Prozorro under a purpose-built donor procedure. The richest forward-looking artefacts are World Bank Procurement Plans and EBRD consultancy/TC assignment notices, with the DREAM ecosystem positioned as the earliest public view of the reconstruction pipeline under the Open Contracting Data Standard. Two structural cautions: the highest-value portals (DREAM, World Bank opportunities) are JavaScript-rendered and returned only loading placeholders on plain fetch, and the US channel has moved from USAID to the State Department, so SAM.gov rather than USAID pages is the correct target. Primary notices in this cell are effectively English-language; Ukrainian-language monitoring belongs on the rules, government-announcement and Prozorro layers rather than the lender portals.
